rationale: Two-line change in src/codemie/agents/langgraph_event_adapter.py: both json.dumps(unpack_json_strings(tool_call["args"])) calls — the streaming tool_calls branch (line 161) and the regular_calls branch (line 228) — now pass ensure_ascii=False. This makes non-ASCII tool arguments (Cyrillic, Azerbaijani, emoji) render as UTF-8 in the emitted tool-start events and debug logs instead of \uXXXX escape sequences. The change affects only the string encoding of the logged/emitted value; the data flow, payload structure, unpack_json_strings behaviour, and the _on_tool_start telemetry contract are unchanged. json.dumps output is consumed by logger.debug and _on_tool_start over UTF-8 streams, so there is no security, correctness, or performance concern. The two call sites are edited identically. No new imports or dependencies.
